objects.description: Attributed witness reports about one identified operational incident.

fields.name: incident_reference
fields.description: Stable identifier for the investigated operational incident.

fields.name: statements
fields.description: Attributed first-person reports made by incident witnesses.

objects.assurance_justification: The reports retain source attribution but have not been corroborated.

objects.description: Incident claims assessed for independence, agreement, and relevance.

fields.name: supported_claims
fields.description: Incident claims supported by mutually independent witness sources.

fields.name: contested_claims
fields.description: Material claims for which available witness sources conflict.

objects.assurance_justification: Support records the stated corroboration policy and preserves disagreement.

objects.description: One defeasible causal mechanism proposed for the operational incident.

fields.name: causal_mechanism
fields.description: Proposed mechanism connecting observed conditions to the incident failure.

fields.name: discriminating_prediction
fields.description: Observable prediction that can distinguish this explanation from alternatives.

objects.assurance_justification: Generation establishes candidacy only, not evidential rank or causal truth.

objects.description: Causal incident hypotheses ordered by an explicit evidential criterion.

fields.name: ordered_hypotheses
fields.description: Candidate causal explanations ordered from strongest to weakest support.

fields.name: ranking_basis
fields.description: Evidence aggregation and tie policy used to establish the order.

objects.assurance_justification: The rank is a defeasible model assessment under the named criterion.

operations.granularity_rationale: Corroboration and ranking form one occurrence here because the source exposes only their joint ranked diagnosis.

skill_composition.contribution: Distinguishes independent support from repeated or contested testimony.
Compares causal mechanisms under the documented evidence criterion.

operations.rationale: The occurrence compares causal explanations rather than proving a single cause.
